The '''reconnaissance mission to Ord Mantell''' was a mission that [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] undertook during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The aim of the mission was to feed the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] false information, leading them to believe that the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] was attempting to establish a new base on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. The Alliance believed this would lead the Empire away from their new base on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].

In order to achieve this misdirection, the Rebel Alliance sent Solo and Skywalker to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to fly [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] on a false reconnaissance mission over the jungle planet.

The two Rebels intentionally allowed their [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to be sighted by an [[Cruiser/Legends|Imperial cruiser]]. Their escape plans were threatened, however, by the appearance of a second cruiser. Skywalker formulated an emergency tactic of merging the two starfighter's [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]]s, effectively doubling their strength and giving the X-wings enough protection to withstand the Imperial [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] and safely jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].

Upon arriving at [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]], Han Solo and Luke Skywalker began to prepare for their next mission: hijacking a large amount of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]]s intended as an Imperial tribute, which was being paid by a shipping company once owned by the [[House of Organa/Legends|Organa]] [[Organa estate|estate]] before the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction of]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. The Rebel Alliance intended to use the credits to fund the purchase of equipment for their new base.

The Rebels' plan called for Han Solo, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] to send a code from Ord Mantell to divert the [[Cargo container/Legends|cargo container]], using Leia's palmprint to access a secret backdoor into the shipping company's secure files. While they were engaged in the attempt, Luke Skywalker and [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] would liberate the container, secreting it away aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] and leaving behind a fake cargo container in its place. Once the stolen container was aboard the ''Millennium Falcon'', Solo's [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Pilot/Legends|co-pilot]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], would activate the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and the Rebels would make their escape.

Before arriving on Ord Mantell, the group was met by their contact, an [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Nalrithian]] named [[Phoedris Bos]], who was to help them infiltrate the command center. Solo privately expressed his distrust of the insectoid [[Agent/Legends|agent]], as its [[Species/Legends|species]] had a "hive mind," which meant that memories would be shared amongst "eggmates." Leia, however, dismissed Han's fears out of hand, explaining that Phoedris had proven his loyalty to the Rebellion by [[Death/Legends|killing]] an eggmate who was about to betray the Rebellion.

On Ord Mantell, Han, Leia, Artoo, and Phoedris made their way to the [[Computer/Legends|computer]] center, and while Artoo was attempting to access the computer, Solo accidentally referred to [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] Leia as "Your Highness," alerting the Nalrithian to the group's true identity. Before Artoo could send the release signal, Phoedris drew his [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] and forced Han to throw away his own [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|blaster]]. "Phoedris" revealed that he was actually [[Cypher Bos]], a notorious [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who was Phoedris' eggmate, and that it had actually been Phoedris who had died in his place. Cypher planned to claim the bounties that the Empire and [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] had placed on Leia Organa and Han Solo, respectively.

Cypher forced R2-D2 to disengage from the computer before he had completed sending the signal, preventing the release of the cargo container's shackle. Cypher then ordered Han to throw away his gunbelt, but Han instead used the belt to whip Cypher's [[Pistol/Legends|pistol]] out of his [[Limb/Legends|hand]]. The two dove for their weapons, but Solo narrowly managed to reach his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] first and killed Cypher.

As the release signal was prematurely shut down, the computer's safety protocols prevented it from being sent again and had activated an alarm, summoning a detachment of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. Once they'd discovered this, the group opted to head back to their [[Starship/Legends|ship]].

Back at the ''Millennium Falcon'', Solo and Organa sent a [[Comlink/Legends|comm message]] to Luke Skywalker, who was still waiting on the container's cargo bay once the alarm sounded and stormtroopers began to arrive. Using his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], Skywalker cut through the container's shackles and warned the crew to prepare for a 'flying catch' before [[Traffic Control]] jammed their transmissions.

Han took off, heading for the loading dock. Traffic Control ordered them to land, but, using a seductive voice, Princess Leia identified herself as [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Valrond]] of the starship ''Victory Ring'', who was running a test on her lifters. This confused the [[Controller/Legends|controller]] into leaving them alone long enough for Solo to maneuver into position. Chewbacca opened the ship's cargo bay and Luke piloted the cargo carrier into the hold, barely stopping in time as the ''Millennium Falcon'' took off into [[Realspace/Legends|space]].
